pins.title: Still Dark When Your Alarm Goes Off? Light Therapy Lamp vs Sunrise Alarm Clock
pins.subtitle: Two tools that do different jobs
pins.description: Your alarm goes off and it's still dark outside. A sunrise alarm clock brightens the room on your nightstand before you wake. A light therapy lamp is bright light you sit near after you're up, at breakfast or your desk. Some people use both. Shopping for a light therapy lamp for dark winter mornings? Start with what each one does. Based on manuals and maker info. Not medical advice. Read the full guide. #lighttherapylamp #sunrisealarmclock #wakeuplight #darkmornings #morningroutine

pins.title: Light Therapy Lamp vs Sunrise Alarm Clock: 300 Lux at Wake-Up or 10,000 Lux After?
pins.subtitle: Why the two numbers aren't comparable
pins.description: Light therapy lamp vs sunrise alarm clock: the brightness numbers aren't the same kind of number. The Philips sunrise alarm we cover lists up to 300 lux, with no distance stated. Lamps say 10,000 lux, but each maker measures at a different distance, from 6 to 24 inches in our picks. We compare three lamps and one sunrise alarm on brightness, timer, and size. Not medical advice. Compare the two. #lighttherapylamp #sunrisealarmclock #wakeuplight #winterbedroom #lightbox

pins.title: Light Therapy Lamp Checklist: 6 Things to Check Before You Buy
pins.subtitle: 10,000 lux at what distance?
pins.description: Save this before buying a light therapy lamp for dark winter mornings. 1) The distance behind 10,000 lux. 2) Whether you can sit at that distance. 3) UV filtering. 4) Brightness levels or a timer. 5) The safety notes on eye conditions, medications, and mental health conditions. 6) That it isn't a red light panel. Eye condition or light-sensitizing medication? Ask a doctor first. Not medical advice. Full checklist in the guide. #lighttherapylamp #lightbox #checklist #darkmornings #homeoffice
